annotations.title: Search Supreme Court of Georgia opinions

description: Full-text search over opinion text, case names, and the labeled summaries. A bare docket or citation is a direct lookup. Search matches the words of the document: ask in the words the court would use. `in_headings` searches only case names, legal areas, and case types.

case_type.description: Kind of case: criminal appeal, civil, bar discipline, habeas, certified question, election, or other.
case_type.title: Case Type

in_headings.description: Search only titles and headings instead of the full text.
in_headings.title: In Headings

limit.description: How many results to return, 1 to 40 (default 10).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: The words to search for, in the words the document itself would use.
query.title: Query

year.description: Only opinions filed in this year.
year.title: Year

name: opinions_search
title: Search Supreme Court of Georgia opinions
